sentences.text: Mongolosaurus was a titanosauriform sauropod dinosaur that lived in China during the Early Cretaceous.
Charles W. Gilmore named and described the species Mongolosaurus haplodon in 1933, and the genus name refers to Mongolia.
The holotype specimen AMNH 6710 was found in the Early Cretaceous On Gong Formation.
Mongolosaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria.
Recent phylogenetic analyses recovered Mongolosaurus as a derived member of the clade Lognkosauria, sister to Jiangxititan.
Mongolosaurus lived between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
